Tools.metaDescription: Position calculator, pre-trade checklist, 100-trade audit, trading journal. Four free tools, one flagship paid product. No ads, no forced sign-up.
Tools.intro: A free tool to calculate before the trade. A flagship paid product to measure after. No tool is built to make you trade more — each one is built to make you trade better.
Tools.ruleText: The free tools cover the calculations and checklists a trader does by hand before entering a position. The flagship paid product automates what a trader does by hand after — journaling, spotting patterns, measuring edge over time. No free feature is crippled to push an upgrade.
Tools.calcDesc: Capital, risk, position size, drawdown projected over 15 consecutive losses. No sign-up. No ads.
Tools.journalDesc: Automated trading journal. Broker CSV import, stats dashboard, Weekly Behavioral Report sent every Sunday evening.
